claim_verdicts.claim: The sky was a clean, very blue color
Birds were calling in the trees
A stream ran alongside the trail

claim_verdicts.quote: Mia laughed the whole way up

claim_verdicts.claim: They ate apples at the summit
Mia clapped her hands at the view
claim_verdicts.quote: she clapped her hands at the wide blue

claim_verdicts.claim: They carried the apples up from the start of the hike
The apples tasted sharper and more honest after the ascent
They did not hurry to leave the summit
The air smelled of thawed earth
The world below arranged itself into ridges and pale distances
The stream was cold and quick beside the path
Mia was quietly delighted at the summit
claim_verdicts.quote: she clapped her hands at the wide blue

notes: The English prose is exceptionally warm and specific, elevating the seed's simple images into a coherent emotional arc without becoming overwrought; 'the sky that day was the real summit' is a standout line. The arc moves cleanly through departure, ascent, summit, and reflection, with every paragraph earning its place. The Russian translation reads as native literary Russian — phrases like 'без причины и по всем причинам сразу' and 'земля показалась доброй' are idiomatic and register-matched, not back-translated. The photo indices (7 frames, spread across 0–11) plausibly trace the arc but the clustering of 9/11 at the end is slightly rear-heavy. Several specific details — Bavarian Alps location, April date, the cold-stream description, the apple-taste reflection — are invented beyond the seed.
